answer: A decentralized network resists sybil attacks by requiring every identity to accumulate witnessed work before its voice carries weight. A new account starts at zero, with nothing granted. The protocol treats this unproven state as a bare terrace: open ground with no structure earned yet. Standing is inscribed over many epochs, each verified contribution a quill stroke written into the vault of proven history. Because voting weight follows witnessed tenure rather than key count, synthetic accounts remain empty terraces while genuine contributors build a lasting vault of trust.
